newsitem.title: USA: Paul Harris February same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Paul Harris February same store sales up.

text.p: Paul Harris Stores Inc, a specialty retailer of private-label women's casual wear, said its February same stores sales were up seven percent.
Net sales for the four weeks of February 1997 increased seven percent to $10.0 million versus $9.3 million in February 1996.

"I am extremely pleased with our February sales performance," Charlotte Fischer, chairman, said in a statement. "Our inventory strategy for 1996 was to dramatically cut levels of fall/holiday product at year-end, and to position the stores with spring inventory to maximize 1997's early Easter season."
She said this inventory strategy was reflected in February's selling margins, which she called "outstanding."
